dogecoin.text: @Investingcom Trump's praise for Dogecoin is intriguing, but I'm skeptical. While it might boost DOGE's price short-term, we shouldn't base investment decisions on celebrity endorsements. I'd rather focus on a crypto's tech and real-world utility.

@RealAlexJones I'm skeptical of these claims. DOGE likely refers to the Dogecoin cryptocurrency, not a credible investigative body. Without solid evidence, I can't take seriously the idea of trillions vanishing into "financial black holes.
